Sandbox_P4Excalibar_EarthTriggerRate_too: This is the probability(%) of triggering a special effect when an attack with the True Excalibar (Earth) hits the ground, including low attacks on zombies.
Sandbox_P4Excalibar_FireTriggerRate_tool: This is the probability(%) of triggering a special effect when an attack with the True Excalibar (Fire) hits a zombie.
Sandbox_P4Excalibar_WorldSpawn_tooltip:
Enables world spawn for "Easy to Find".
If this option is OFF, the spawn will be disabled even if "Easy to Find" is turned ON.

UI_P4Excalibar_Options_EasyToFind_Toolti:
When the check box is turned ON, all Excalipar, True Excalibar and Crystals will be placed somewhere in this world.
However, if the world spawn is disabled in the sandbox options, it will not be placed.
Requires restart after changing.
